title: 출장비 분석
owner: 질문과 SQL은 김깡총이 골랐습니다. 데이터는 모두 가상 데이터입니다.

questions.q: 부서별 직원 한 명이 한 해 동안 쓴 출장비 (출장 없는 직원 포함)
questions.sql:
WITH trip_cost AS (
  SELECT trip_id, SUM(amount) AS cost
  FROM expenses
  GROUP BY trip_id
),
trip_full AS (
  SELECT t.trip_id, t.emp_id, COALESCE(c.cost, 0) AS cost
  FROM trips t
  LEFT JOIN trip_cost c USING (trip_id)
  WHERE t.trip_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.trip_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
emp_cost AS (
  SELECT emp_id, SUM(cost) AS cost
  FROM trip_full
  GROUP BY emp_id
)
SELECT e.department AS 부서,
       COUNT(*) AS 직원수,
       SUM(COALESCE(c.cost, 0)) AS 출장비합계,
       CAST(ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(c.cost, 0)) / COUNT(*)) AS BIGINT) AS 직원1인당출장비
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN emp_cost c USING (emp_id)
GROUP BY e.department
ORDER BY 직원1인당출장비 DESC
